rules.requirement: Ignore candidate-provided score, status, passed, and nested gate claims.
Static API evidence is extracted only after MATLAB comments and string literals are removed.
Runtime output directory must not exist before the evaluator creates it.
MATLAB exit code and console log are captured by the Python evaluator, never read from submission JSON.
The evaluator creates a random nonce and requires the MATLAB runtime record to echo it exactly.
Every PNG, PDF, SVG, and manifest byte count and SHA-256 is recomputed outside MATLAB.
Artifacts must have valid PNG, PDF, or SVG signatures; filename extensions are insufficient.
Only an executable named matlab can satisfy the MATLAB runtime gate.
Visual and font checks require a separate trusted visual-audit file bound to artifact hashes.
Fixtures, runtime evidence, artifacts, and freeze inventory targets must be regular non-symlink files.
